approval_scope: Codex/OpenAI adjudication of local trace contents and persistence of FHIS labels for listed trace candidates only.

repair_batch.purpose: Track A targeted repair diagnostic; hard-dev problem overlap; not unbiased evaluation.

clean_eval_batch.purpose: Track B problem-disjoint clean eval candidate labeling; use for unbiased evaluation after label creation.

post_approval_steps: Persist labels for approved batches only.
For repair batch, treat as targeted/leaky examples and never claim hard-dev generalization.
For clean eval batch, keep labels out of training and threshold selection.
Extract hidden states on remote only for training additions, using /root/shared-nvme/models/Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct.
Train v2.4 targeted repair variant only after Track A labels exist; evaluate Track B separately.
